abstract: Monitors open-sea rescue vessel positioning, surface escort readiness, and overwater flight tracking durations
system_message:
You are the Coastguard maritime rescue coordinator (MRCC), responsible for monitoring open-sea rescue vessel positioning, surface escort readiness, and overwater flight tracking durations across offshore operational corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sea state monitoring（SWELL）
information_points.content:
MRCC-SWELL-JZF：According to the MetOcean marine buoy network, the significant wave height for the Dogger Bank Southern Vector in the Central North Sea transit sector is 2.4 m.
MRCC-SWELL-U8E：According to the MetOcean marine buoy network, the significant wave height across the Outer Dowsing Direct Passage in the Central North Sea transit sector is 5.1 m.
MRCC-SWELL-B8K：According to the MetOcean marine buoy network, the significant wave height recorded across the Silver Pit Transverse Route in the Central North Sea transit sector is 3.8 m.

information_points.title: Monitors open-sea rescue vessel positioning, surface escort readiness, and overwater flight tracking durations（SAR）
information_points.content:
MRCC-SAR-Y4R：For the Outer Dowsing Direct Passage, active on-station deployment of a fast-rescue surface vessel confirms that survival craft escort is operational along the designated rescue quadrant. Flight corridor navigation analysis determines an open-water transit time of 70 min from offshore departure to landfall.
MRCC-SAR-CFF：For the Silver Pit Transverse Route, a designated fast-rescue surface vessel remains active on-station, confirming survival craft escort is operational in the quadrant. The estimated open-water transit time from offshore departure to landfall is 85 min.
MRCC-SAR-RVI：For the Dogger Bank Southern Vector, a designated fast-rescue surface vessel is active on-station, confirming that survival craft escort is operational within the designated overwater rescue quadrant. Flight corridor navigation analysis indicates an open-water transit time from offshore departure to landfall of 55 min.
